frozen_artifact_evidence.exploitation_evidence: Incorrect vote counting affects the integrity of the voting system.
frozen_artifact_evidence.fix_strategy_evidence: Modify the "storage checkpoint" to "memory checkpoint" in both the delegate() and removeDelegation() functions.
frozen_artifact_evidence.root_cause_evidence: When updating the voting proxy, both the old and new checkpoints were updated, causing the previous checkpoint to erroneously include the latest changes.
